message.content: On September 16th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz suggested incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. He proposed this idea because he believed it could significantly enhance their jazz fusion skills and make the practice sessions more enjoyable and creative. Additionally, WolfgangSchulz expressed optimism that the inclusion of improvisation would challenge them as musicians and contribute to their growth. LiHua enthusiastically agreed, suggesting that improvisation would make their sessions more fun and creative, and they were eager to try it out. Yuriko Yamamoto also expressed excitement about the prospect, noting that it would allow them to express themselves musically and that she looked forward to seeing what everyone would bring to the table.
